Fig. 4: Pareto frontier analysis of lightweight retinal vessel segmentation methods across five datasets (DRIVE, STARE, CHASE DB1, HRF, FIVES). Each row corresponds to one dataset with two columns: (1) Sensitivity (SE) vs. model parameters, and (2) F1-score vs. model parameters. The x-axis is plotted on a logarithmic scale. LightVesselNet achieves competitive accuracy with significantly fewer parameters, positioning it on or near the Pareto frontier in most cases.
